title: Robust Multi-Library PDF Processing Service
description: Implement robust PDF text extraction service with multiple library fallbacks to replace failing pdf.js implementation in edge runtime.
acceptance_criteria: ✅ Multi-library fallback system (pdf.js → pdf-parse → MuPDF → Poppler)
✅ Confidence scoring system to detect metadata vs content
✅ Edge runtime compatibility for all libraries
technical_notes: Implement confidence scoring based on text patterns
Add metadata detection to avoid processing PDF internals
Update process-document function to use new service
Add monitoring for extraction method success rates
risk_assessment: Medium - Multiple external libraries, edge runtime constraints
